entities.summary: Algernon Bertram Freeman-Mitford, 1st Baron Redesdale, was a British diplomat, collector and writer, whose most notable work is Tales of Old Japan (1871). Nicknamed "Bertie", he was the paternal grandfather of the Mitford sisters.
